description: Classic Ragnarok Online town map perspective, fixed elevated three-quarter overhead orthographic camera looking north, upright front-facing buildings, horizontal east-west streets and vertical north-south streets, rectangular paving grid aligned with image edges. Original Global Shaman sanctuary town, warm sandstone central town square, small circular turquoise ritual fountain in middle, Thai-inspired Medium academy along upper left, talisman shops along upper right, spirit gate at north street, grass gardens and spirit lanterns. Walkable plaza takes central and lower half; buildings human-scale and evenly spaced. Crisp detailed classic MMORPG pixel art, warm daylight, earthy cream ochre green teal palette. Entire image is a flat full map viewport, all corners filled with town terrain, no horizon, no diamond-shaped island, no diagonal isometric block grid, no floating diorama, no dramatic cinematic perspective, no giant tree, no cliffside terraces, no UI, no text, no characters.
